rules.title: Accessibility violation
rules.description: img without alt, form control without label, click-handler-only divs, or contrast-breaking color-only state.

rules.title: Inline styles
rules.description: style attributes with reusable or state-dependent styling that belongs in classes.

rules.title: !important overuse
rules.description: !important used to win specificity fights instead of fixing selector structure — escalates into unmaintainable CSS.

rules.title: Fragile high-specificity selectors
rules.description: ID selectors or deep descendant chains (>3 levels) that break on any markup change.

rules.title: Non-semantic markup
rules.description: div/span soup where semantic elements (nav, main, button, table) carry meaning, improve a11y, and reduce ARIA need.
